newsitem.title: USA: Laboratory Corp completes rights offering.
newsitem.headline: Laboratory Corp completes rights offering.

text.p: Laboratory Corp of America said it has completed a rights offering of 8.5 percent Series A Convertible Exchangeable Preferred Stock and 8.5 percent Series B Convertible Pay-in-Kind Preferred Stock.

Under the offering, rights were exercised to purchase 4,363,202 shares of 8.5 percent Series A Convertible Exchangeable Preferred Stock and 5,636,798 shares of 8.5 percent Series B Convertible Pay-in-Kind Preferred Stock for an aggregate purchase price of $500 million.

Roche Holdings Inc, the owner of about 49.9 percent of LabCorp's common stock, exercised its basic subscription privilege in full for 4,988,522 shares of 8.5 percent Series B Convertible Pay-in-Kind Preferred Stock and other rights holders purchased the remaining 5,011,478 shares.
LabCorp is a clinical laboratory organization, operating primary testing facilities.
